{{Quote|Yellow star: Makem. Third planet: Makem Te. Arid, pebbly, no oceans, one large ice cap.|First Republic assessment of Makem Te|<ref name="GATORW" />}}
'''Makem Te''' was the dry [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]] [[Species/Legends|species]], on the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]].

==History==
{{Quote|Flew a cruiser filled with Republic soldiers into Makem Te during its rebellion. That was a scary business.|[[Unidentified retired Galactic Republic pilot|A retired pilot]], to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Kitster Chanchani Banai|Kitster Banai]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref>}}
Originally an independent world ruled by the [[Congress of Caliphs]], Makem Te was conquered by [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]], being absorbed into his ever-expanding [[Xim's empire|empire]]. Upon its collapse in [[25,096 BBY]], the world once again was left on its own. Eventually discovered by the Republic between the [[Kymoodon Era]] and [[Rianitus Period]], Makem Te quickly joined the galactic government, gaining representation in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].

During the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] fled to the planet, driven away from [[Thule/Legends|Thule]].<ref name="TEA" /> In [[3963 BBY]], the world was invaded by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. During the [[Jedi Civil War]], Makem Te aligned with the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]], which had offered freedom from the Mandalorians. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], there was a brief [[Battle of Makem Te (Cold War)|battle]] in Makem Te's upper atmosphere between the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] and the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], in which the Republic emerged victorious. Upon the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Darth Malak]], the world stayed neutral until the [[New Sith Wars]] began in [[2000 BBY/Legends|2000 BBY]]. Located in [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Space]], which had expanded from [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], the planet did not suffer any major battles during the war.

[[File:MakemTe_TheTract.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The [[Tract of Makem Te]]]]

After years of alignment with the Sith, the world rejoined the Republic, with Senator [[Yeb Yeb Adem'thorn]] representing the Swokes Swokes in the Galactic Senate. As the mining corporations of the Republic moved in on the world, the rebel sect known as the [[Temple of the Beatific Razor]] arose. In [[42 BBY/Legends|42 BBY]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] stopped a bloody civil war between the Temple and the reigning [[Caliph]]s on the planet; young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] met a [[Unidentified retired Galactic Republic pilot|veteran]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the battle in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Eventually the world seceded from the Republic again during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] as [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] had revealed plans to destroy the resurgent Temple group.<ref name="GATORW" />

With the end of the Clone Wars, Makem Te was quick to rejoin the newly formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Within its second decade of existence, the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] swept the Outer Rim, with battle coming to Makem Te. As the Empire won the [[Battle of Makem Te (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Makem Te]], the planet continued to thrive, continuing to provide lasting support to the Empire after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], though the world was isolated from the Empire after a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Battle of Emmer (4 ABY)|victory]] at [[Emmer]]. An Imperial fortress world during the [[Ssi-ruuvi invasions|Ssi-ruuvi]] and [[Nagai–Tof War|Nagai invasions]], General [[Zsinj]] held off advances by the invaders and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] until his death. Taken swiftly by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], the world continued to be pro-Imperial until forced to help the New Republic during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Injured but not devastated by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], Makem Te was eventually absorbed into [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]].

==Society==
Every Swokes Swokes who died was afforded a plot in the [[Tract of Makem Te]], an enormous graveyard which covered ten percent of the planet's surface.

The [[Spice/Legends|spice]] trade was of high market value across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], with Makem Te providing a notable production line for smugglers.
